svg.title: Self-cell membrane patch
svg.desc: Native cartoon rebuilt from the current detailed component style; not a recolored copy of the old PIRCHE geometry. Lipid bilayer with current HLA-I cartoon.

g.inkscape:label: Detailed membrane patch with phospholipid bilayer and oriented molecule
Phospholipid bilayer: heads and paired fatty-acid tails
HLA-I: one heavy-chain membrane anchor and extracellular beta2m
HLA class I / HLA-E peptide complex
Heavy chain: stalk, single transmembrane helix and cytoplasmic tail
User free-form peptide in HLA groove
User free-form nine-residue core, native vectors
